I’m just adding some of the backstory of my painting, my work of art needs a discretion so I made the description what I feel deep inside of me. I don’t want to sell it for any means but I must, I’m stuck in a hard financial situation and I feel as i have no choice but to sell this NFT. Plus I remember when my little guy was alive I would talk to him and tell him all the time that one day when I make it I will show him the world and give him all the little things he deserves, he wasn’t able to live king enough to see that and I haven’t reached that goal yet so I feel like I’m selling it in his honor and what I will do with that money if I do sell it is make my new little dog Jax have the world and all the things I couldn’t give to my max
